The White House recently announced the formation of a “tiger team” dedicated to preventing major mess-ups like the recent multi-hour ground stop , which snarled airports nationwide as a mountain of delayed and rescheduled flights piled up.

headlines.headline: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price. Traders see even more pain
headlines.description: Anthropic shares fell below the $83 IPO price as options activity surged, with large put buys, call buys and put sales pointing to a divided market.
